---
title: "Download ADCP 1.1"
---

ADCP 1.1 runs on **Linux**. The installation script uses (or creates) a micromamba or conda
environment called `adcpsuite` with Python 3.7. It installs everything ADCP 1.1 needs, plus
[agfrgui](/software/agfr/index.qmd), the graphical tool for generating the target files
that describe receptors.

## Linux with micromamba

::: {.panel-tabset}

### 1. Install micromamba

In a shell, go to your home folder and fetch the micromamba binary:

```bash
cd ~; curl -Ls https://micro.mamba.pm/api/micromamba/linux-64/latest | tar -xvj bin/micromamba
```

Install micromamba:

```bash
bin/micromamba shell init -s bash -p `pwd`/micromamba
```

Activate micromamba:

```bash
source ~/.bashrc
```

### 2. Install ADCP 1.1

Download the [installation script](https://ccsb.scripps.edu/mamba/scripts/adcpsuite_micromamba.sh), or:

```bash
wget https://ccsb.scripps.edu/mamba/scripts/adcpsuite_micromamba.sh
```

Run it:

```bash
sh ./adcpsuite_micromamba.sh
```

This installs ADCP 1.1 with all required packages and dependencies.

### 3. Use the software

Activate the environment:

```bash
micromamba activate adcpsuite
```

You can now run ADCP by typing `adcp` in your shell, and AGFRgui by typing `agfrgui`.

:::

## Linux with conda

::: {.panel-tabset}

### 1. Install conda

If conda is not installed yet, follow
[the conda installation instructions](https://docs.conda.io/projects/conda/en/stable/user-guide/install/linux.html).

### 2. Install ADCP 1.1

Download the [installation script](https://ccsb.scripps.edu/mamba/scripts/adcpsuite_conda.sh), or:

```bash
wget https://ccsb.scripps.edu/mamba/scripts/adcpsuite_conda.sh
```

Run it:

```bash
sh ./adcpsuite_conda.sh
```

This installs ADCP 1.1 with all required packages and dependencies.

### 3. Use the software

Activate the environment:

```bash
micromamba activate adcpsuite
```

You can now run ADCP by typing `adcp` in your shell, and AGFRgui by typing `agfrgui`.

:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## Review note (prototype only)
The CCSB page uses `micromamba activate` in the conda instructions too. For a conda install this
is presumably `conda activate adcpsuite`. Please confirm before the page goes live.
:::

## macOS

ADCP can run on macOS with Apple Silicon (M1/M2) at near-native speed inside an Ubuntu virtual
machine. Follow
[these instructions](https://rwxayheee.github.io/ADCP-Suite-and-AGFRGUI-in-Ubuntu-VM-on-Apple-Silicon#install-the-adcp-suite)
to install the UTM virtualization app with an Ubuntu virtual machine running ADCP 1.1.
